# China Highlights

> > Comprehensive China travel resource covering tours, destinations, cultural guides, and transportation across Beijing, Shanghai, Xi'an, Zhangjiajie, Chengdu, and beyond.

China Highlights is a leading China travel service offering curated tour packages, detailed destination guides, high-speed rail booking assistance, and cultural insights into Chinese traditions, cuisine, and attractions including the Great Wall, Terracotta Warriors, and Forbidden City.

## Key Topics

- China travel and tourism
- Beijing, Shanghai, Xi'an, Zhangjiajie, Chengdu, Guangzhou
- Great Wall of China
- Terracotta Warriors and Terracotta Army
- Forbidden City
- High-speed rail and bullet trains
- Chinese culture and traditions
- Multi-city tour itineraries
- Chinese cuisine and food culture
- Chinese zodiac and astrology
- Panda experiences
- Silk Road tours
- Winter activities and skiing
- Lunar New Year celebrations
